title: Review check hides request and response details
root_cause: The script emits the same failure for an unsuccessful GitHub request and for a successful response without the expected phrase. The masked token's permissions and the response body are unavailable, so a scope problem and an incorrect content expectation are both plausible.

relevant_evidence.why: Only the generic review failure and exit are visible.
A failed request and a nonmatching body lead to the same result.
